description: A complex disease involving an excessive amount of body fat.
causes: Taking in more calories than you burn through exercise and normal daily activities.
symptoms: Body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher
prevention: Healthy diet and regular physical activity.
treatment_action: Dietary changes, exercise, behavior change, and sometimes weight-loss medications or surgery.
complications: Heart disease, type 2 diabetes, and certain cancers.

prevention: No known way to prevent, but early treatment can help.
complications: Excessive time spent engaging in ritualistic behaviors and poor quality of life.

description: A condition that causes bones to become weak and brittle.
causes: Bone loss that occurs as you age.
symptoms: A bone that breaks much more easily than expected
prevention: Adequate calcium and vitamin D intake, and weight-bearing exercise.
treatment_action: Medications to strengthen bones and lifestyle changes.
complications: Bone fractures, particularly in the spine or hip.
